messages.author: 085b00b73e467d88
messages.subject: Re: function "MaxQtoMSstatsFormat"
parts:
Based on your error message, it seems MSstats was not successfully loaded and R couldn't find the function "MaxQtoMSstatsFormat". I checked with MSstats 3.8.2 on my side and didn't have the issue. Could you share your .log file? This would help identify possible reasons.

Thanks,
Tsung-Heng

messages.author: 085b00b73e467d88
messages.subject: Re: function "MaxQtoMSstatsFormat"
parts:
As using other R packages, every time you launch R, you need to load the package:
library(MSstats)

There is no need to re-install the package every time unless there is an updated version. Your working environment (either normal R GUI or an IDE like RStudio) doesn't matter.
